headings: This document is an offline copy of Monitor and NHS England’s 2016/17 national tariff consultation survey. It’s designed to help stakeholders by letting them know the questions we’re asking, and to enable organisations with a number of staff inputting into responses to coordinate their responses.
If you have any problems with completing the survey please contact us at pricing@monitor.gov.uk
